gate_policy: All listed criteria and dependency reviews must pass. The script checks integrity, not visual truth.

criteria.description: New standalone project directory and local Git root; zero legacy code/assets imported; old project and saves untouched
Actual versions/commands and working Blender export-to-runtime calibration
Fresh calibration scene captured; new harness/physics smoke tests and serialization/storage-isolation tests run honestly
Isolated automation, safe integration gate check and production boundaries established
Exact-year fleet references, dimensions, uncertainties and scale blockouts
Slingshot primary geometry matches neutral multiview references
Runtime scale/axes/pivots/contact layout/mount naming verified
Editable Blender source and actual runtime GLB comparison evidence
Real three-contact chassis/suspension/tire model; no spline-pinned player
Steering/braking/reverse/traction/surfaces and camera work coherently
One authoritative drivetrain/RPM/gear/wheel telemetry source
Rest/bump/seam/collision/frame-cap tests and inspected motion evidence
Finished hero/cockpit/rider/part mounts pass neutral runtime review
Garage and track sample pass actual day/night material/light comparison
Required slice cameras, lamps and telemetry-driven audio inspected
Measured representative rendering profile meets stated desktop target on recorded physical hardware
Finished benchmark course and three physics-constrained rivals; inspected full races
Valid checkpoints/results, idempotent rewards, new-game save/load, and isolation from legacy storage verified
SM-133/SM-3223/SM-7720 correctly fit, install, restore, save and show effects
Safe exact-product build links; no live-site dependency or fabricated facts
Full garage-race-upgrade-retry loop reviewed day/night with audio and performance evidence
All three finished vehicles/riders/LODs/reference comparisons pass
F3-T SE6 and Ryker CVT behave distinctly with honest setup provenance
Curated release products/options/assets and exclusions verified per platform
Each starting vehicle works with declared fair class/event rules and saved builds
Five destinations individually accepted with representative runtime evidence
Eight freshly authored chapters/roughly 24 connected events; no legacy script/ID/progress imports
Campaign completable for each platform without real purchases; rewards/replays audited
Ghosts, personal records, photo mode and completed camera/input options tested
Declared target browsers/controllers/physical mobile tests and quality tiers actually verified
Full functional/performance/accessibility/save/load regression report inspected
Public asset permissions, secrets and privacy/commerce boundaries reviewed with evidence
Reproducible build, rollback and confirmed authorized deployment route; no unapproved production promotion
